title: Rodomontade
summary: RODOMONTA'DE, noun [See Rodomont.] Vain boasting; empty bluster or vaunting; rant. I could show that the rodomontades of Almanzor are neither so irrational nor impossible. RODOMONTA'DE, verb intransit

inlines.v: RODOMONTA'DE, noun [See Rodomont.] Vain boasting; empty bluster or vaunting; rant. I could show that the rodomontades of Almanzor are neither so irrational nor impossible. RODOMONTA'DE, verb intransitive To boast; to brag; to bluster; to rant.
